LESSON: PHONOLOGICAL AWARENESS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Listening and Speaking Phonological awareness Intonation, articulation, blending
Topic 1.1: Phonological Awareness

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Phonological Awareness
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is it important to articulate tones correctly in Chinese?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify initials and finals in Chinese
2. appreciate the uniqueness of the Chinese language
3. appreciate the importance of articulating initials and finals in communication

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: identify initials and finals in Chinese
• Model 2: appreciate the uniqueness of the Chinese language
• Model 3: appreciate the importance of articulating initials and finals in communication

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: identify initials and finals in Chinese
2. Practise: appreciate the uniqueness of the Chinese language
3. Practise: appreciate the importance of articulating initials and finals in communication

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Phonological Awareness.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to articulate tones correctly in Chinese?
2. What strategies can you use to speak Chinese clearly?
